name: world-studio
description: A Roblox-Studio-style 3D editor for Volt games. Place parts, pillars, lights, spawn points, your own .glb models and the rigged characters that come with Volt Studio; drag things into each other in the Things list so a sword carries its gem, its script and its effects; and walk around what you built with the same walking, running, jumping and crouching the finished game has. A Script is plain Volt that runs at the start, every frame, or when the player is close; an Effect is a burst of glowing specks a script can set off by name. Save writes the world between two marker lines in your .volt file, so your own settings and code are never touched. Needs the game-kit plugin (the player) and the character-pack plugin (the characters).
